description: Read an MEP identity or membership history including published committee, delegation, and political-group records. Default section overview returns identity and membership_count; section memberships pages full membership records. Missing end dates do not establish current membership. Continue memberships with page.next_offset and snapshot; restart at offset 0 without snapshot after snapshot_changed. Missing detail succeeds with found false; discover IDs with euparl_search_meps.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

mep_id.description: Decimal person ID, person/ prefix, or exact https://data.europarl.europa.eu/person/ URI.

section.description: Default overview returns identity and membership count; memberships returns the selected history page.

snapshot.description: Returned membership snapshot; required for membership offset above 0, optional at offset 0.

name: euparl_get_mep

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

citizenship.description: Published citizenship; distinct from country of representation.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Person identifier or language is unsupported. `invalid_mode_fields`: Overview has nonzero offset or membership continuation lacks a snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: The complete membership collection or normalized scope changed. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

membership_count.description: Parsed membership count on a found overview; absent relations do not prove no membership history.

memberships.description: Selected membership history page; present only on a found memberships response.

items.description: Published historical membership and available interval.

end_date.description: Published membership interval end date; absence does not establish current membership.

organization_id.description: Published organization identity; resolve supported decimal organization IDs with euparl_list_reference topic organizations and organization_ids.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Membership continuation metadata; absent on overview or missing detail.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

place_of_birth.description: Published place of birth, never inferred from citizenship.

section.description: Identity overview or separately paged membership history.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.

title: Read a member and membership history
